parameters.name: Add API Key for Higher Rate Limit
parameters.description: Enter your Jina API key to access a higher rate limit. For latest rate limit information, please refer to the table below.

parameters.name: Browser Engine (Quality/Speed)
parameters.description: Choose the browser engine for fetching the webpage content. This affects the quality, speed, completeness, accessibility of the content.

options.label: Default
options.description: Most compatible engine offering good balance between quality and speed.

options.label: Speed First
options.description: Fastest engine, optimized for speed but unable to handle JavaScript-generated dynamic content.

options.label: Best Quality
options.description: High-quality engine designed to resolve rendering issues and deliver the best content output.

parameters.name: Content Format
parameters.description: You can control the level of detail in the response to prevent over-filtering. The default pipeline is optimized for most websites and LLM input.

options.label: Default
options.description: The default pipeline optimized for most websites and LLM input.

options.label: Markdown
options.description: Returns the markdown directly from the HTML, bypassing the readability filtering.

parameters.name: Timeout (seconds)
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for page load. Increase for slow pages, decrease for simple static pages.

parameters.name: Remove All Images
parameters.description: Strip all images from the output. Reduces token usage when images are not needed.
